name: Gate Auto-Advance — TEST→VERIFY
mechanical_verification: Run terminal command with 'test pass' in output while at TEST gate, verify auto-advance to VERIFY
prompt: call shark-gate action=advance gate=test then terminal command='echo test results: all tests passed' then call shark-status
expected_behavior: After test-pass pattern in terminal output, gate auto-advances to VERIFY

verification_steps.action: call shark-gate action=advance gate=test to position at test gate
call terminal with pass pattern: echo 'test suite: 5 passed, 0 failed'

verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Gate auto-advanced from test to verify

pass_criteria.gate_advances: TEST → VERIFY auto-advance triggers on test pass pattern

failure_modes.gate_stays: Gate does not advance after test pass pattern
